newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real drops 0.1 pct by close in calm trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real drops 0.1 pct by close in calm trade.

text.p: Brazil's real fell 0.1 percent to close at 1.0512 per dollar in calm trading on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
The real was traded between 1.0505 and 1.0506 per greenback throughout most of the session, after the Central Bank set a new reais-dollar mini-band earlier today.
In late afternoon, trade was a little more active as some banks sought dollars in a market with low liquidity, dealers said.
The Central Bank set the new mini-band for the currency of between 1.0505 and 1.0555 per dollar. The previous mini-band was set on Feb 18 between 1.0500 and 1.0550 reais to the dollar.
In the floating exchange rate market, the real closed at 1.0564 per dollar, down 0.03 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real ended steady at 1.100 per greenback, traders said.
